inlines.v: BROOCH, noun broche. 1. An ornamental utensil for fastening the vest, or the bosom of a shirt, as formerly used in America. It is usually made of silver, often round, with a tongue crossing its diameter, sometimes with two tongues. It formerly was used in England, as it was in America, and is still in the highlands of Scotland. 2. A jewel. 3. With painters, a painting all of one color. BROOCH, verb transitive To adorn or furnish with brooches or jewels.
